questions.question: Jhumpa Lahiri's story collection Interpreter of Maladies features multiple stories about romantic relationships. In "This Blessed House," newlyweds argue over whether to replace items left by the previous owners of their new in "A Temporary Matter," a husband and wife attempt to rekindle their relationship during a four- home. _ night blackout. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

To discover which fruit varieties were grown in Italy's Umbria region before the introduction of industrial farming, botanist Isabella Dalla Ragione often turns to centuries-old lists of cooking ingredients. she analyzes Renaissance paintings of Umbria, as they can provide accurate representations of fruits that were grown there long ago. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

"Wishcycling"-putting nonrecyclable items into recycling bins under the mistaken belief that those items can be recycled—ultimately does more harm than good. Nonrecyclable items, such as greasy pizza boxes, can contaminate recyclable materials, rendering entire batches unusable. _ nonrecyclable products can damage recycling plants' machinery. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

Installing rooftop solar panels reduced the community center's daytime electricity purchases. ______, adding a battery allowed the center to draw less electricity from the grid during the evening peak. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The second sentence adds another benefit to the first; In addition signals that additive relationship.

questions.question: Reviewers have praised the novel's vivid descriptions of coastal landscapes. ______, several critics have highlighted its inventive shifts between first- and third-person narration. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The second positive observation supplements the first, so Moreover is the logical additive transition.

questions.question: Along the restored riverbank, native grasses reduce soil erosion during heavy rain. ______, the plants provide shade that helps keep shallow water cooler in summer. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The shade benefit is another advantage of the grasses, so Additionally properly signals added information.

questions.question: The language-learning app gives users immediate audio feedback on pronunciation. ______, it lets users replay difficult phrases at a slower speed. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The replay feature is an additional feature, and Furthermore signals addition rather than contrast or cause.

questions.question: The new telescope can detect planets too faint to be seen by earlier instruments. ______, its spectrograph can identify several gases in some of those planets' atmospheres. Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The ability to analyze atmospheric gases is another capability of the telescope, so Moreover is appropriate.

questions.question:
The new archive catalog lets researchers search by author and date.
______ it links each record to a high-resolution image of the document.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The second sentence adds another catalog feature, so an additive transition is required.

questions.question:
The community garden supplies fresh produce to a neighborhood pantry.
______ it offers weekend workshops on composting and seed saving.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The workshops are an additional contribution, not a contrast or consequence.

questions.question:
The coating protects outdoor signs from rain.
______ it reduces fading caused by ultraviolet light.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The second protection supplements the first.

questions.question:
The first wetland site supported more frog species after restoration.
______ the second restored site showed an increase in dragonfly species.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The second site shows a parallel positive pattern, making Similarly appropriate.

questions.question:
The redesigned website loads more quickly on older phones.
______ its text can be enlarged without disrupting the page layout.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The accessibility feature is additional information about the redesign.

questions.question:
The train's regenerative brakes return energy to the battery.
______ lightweight seats reduce the energy needed for acceleration.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The seating change is a separate added energy-saving feature.

questions.question:
The course includes weekly practice quizzes.
______ students receive detailed feedback after each quiz.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The feedback is another course feature, so the relationship is additive.

questions.question:
The new trail gives pedestrians a safer route across the valley.
______ viewing platforms along the trail overlook several waterfalls.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The scenic benefit adds to the safety benefit.

questions.question:
The portable sensor measures soil moisture.
______ it records soil temperature at the same location.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The temperature measurement is another capability.

questions.question:
The library's mobile unit delivers books to rural communities.
______ it provides internet access for residents completing online forms.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. Internet access supplements the book-delivery service.

questions.question:
One species of native grass stabilizes the restored dune.
______ another native species supplies seeds eaten by shorebirds.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The second species contributes another beneficial function parallel to the first.

questions.question:
The translation preserves the play's informal dialogue.
______ it retains the wordplay in several important scenes.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The retained wordplay is a second achievement of the translation.

questions.question:
The renovated market includes wider aisles for wheelchairs.
______ its signs use large lettering and high-contrast colors.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The sign design is another accessibility improvement.

questions.question:
The telescope can track rapidly moving objects.
______ it can automatically correct for small vibrations in its mount.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. Automatic correction is an added telescope capability.

questions.question:
The town's tree inventory records the location of each tree.
______ it notes which trees need pruning or disease inspection.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The maintenance information supplements the location data.

questions.question:
The insulated container keeps meals warm during delivery.
______ a removable divider prevents different foods from mixing.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The divider is an additional product benefit.

questions.question:
The updated map marks accessible building entrances.
______ it identifies elevators that are temporarily out of service.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The elevator information adds another accessibility-related function.

questions.question:
The rain garden captures runoff from the school roof.
______ native flowers in the garden provide food for pollinating insects.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The pollinator benefit is additional to stormwater capture.

questions.question:
The digital edition allows readers to search the novel's text.
______ it includes recordings of the author reading selected passages.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The recordings are another feature of the digital edition.

questions.question:
The new bicycle racks are covered to protect bicycles from rain.
______ each rack includes a built-in repair stand.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The repair stand adds a separate benefit.

questions.question:
The research station monitors air quality throughout the year.
______ it shares its measurements through a public online dashboard.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Public data access supplements the station's monitoring role.

questions.question:
The theater's youth program teaches acting and stage movement.
______ participants learn basic lighting and sound design.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
questions.explanation: D is correct. Technical instruction is another component of the program.
